image.why: A 1613 portrait of the hermit pope from L'Aquila

summary.en: Pietro da Morrone, a hermit elected pope in July 1294 after a two-year deadlock. He abdicated after five months, and his successor, Boniface VIII, annulled nearly all his acts.

en: Founded the Celestine order, a branch of the Benedictines
